intermediate.title: Red Bull KM | Caprita d'Orba (161.6 km)

story: After an early fight, five riders formed what seemed to be the breakaway of the day, but the peloton kept the gap small and caught them after 75 kilometres. More attacks followed before a new move went clear with many of the same riders. On the climbs, Movistar set a fierce pace, dropping sprinters like Groenewegen, Magnier and Milan. Milan and Magnier chased for a long time but never made it back. A reduced peloton prepared for a sprint until Alec Segaert attacked with just over 3km remaining and soloed to victory.
